value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Schedule or cancel inspections via IVR at (707) 317-1070, SelecTXT at (866) 752-4311, or through eTRAKiT
The building permit, approved plans, and supporting documentation must be available to the inspector on site; no inspection will be conducted without them
Re-inspection fees may apply if the project isn't ready, the inspector cannot gain entry, the permit card/approved plans aren't on site, or the inspection is canceled after 6:00am
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.notes: The City's own page states applicants using its Symbium-based automated platform (SB 379 compliant) 'will be able to apply for instantaneous plan review approval,' while all other photovoltaic/energy storage applications submitted via e-TRAKiT are 'subject to plan review' with 'permit processing [taking] approximately 1-3 business days, depending on staff availability.' The 0-3 day range reflects instant issuance for the Symbium-eligible pathway and up to 3 business days for the standard pathway.
